indiamart.typical_moq_notes: MOQ varies hugely by seller tier — even verified/TrustSEAL suppliers often quote a high opening MOQ that is frequently negotiable downward for a first order.
verification_red_flags: No independently verifiable business registration or GST number
Refuses to provide a sample before a bulk order
Pricing significantly below the category norm with no clear explanation
Only accepts full advance payment with no partial-payment option
verification_best_practices: Cross-check the GST number independently — don't rely on a listing badge alone
Always obtain at least one physical sample before committing to MOQ
Get pricing in writing across at least two order-size tiers to check for consistency
indiamart.negotiation_notes: Opening quotes on IndiaMART are frequently negotiable 10-20% down, especially once a genuine repeat-order relationship is established.

tradeindia.typical_moq_notes: A similar profile to IndiaMART, but the seller base skews slightly more toward manufacturers with export experience, sometimes with higher minimums.
verification_red_flags: No independently verifiable business registration or GST number
Refuses to provide a sample before a bulk order
Communication only through personal chat apps, with no business email or domain
verification_best_practices: Verify export/trade history independently if it's claimed in the listing
Request references from prior buyers where feasible
Confirm Incoterms (who pays freight/insurance) in writing before ordering
tradeindia.negotiation_notes: Sellers with genuine export experience are often more receptive to a formal Proforma Invoice negotiation than informal chat-based haggling.

manufacturer_direct.typical_moq_notes: Usually the highest MOQ of any sourcing channel, but the best achievable per-unit pricing and the most control over customization.
verification_red_flags: Unwilling to allow a factory audit or even a video call
No formal quality-control process can be described when asked
verification_best_practices: Request a pre-shipment inspection report, or arrange independent third-party QC
Clarify tooling/mold costs upfront if any customization is involved
manufacturer_direct.negotiation_notes: Direct manufacturer relationships reward volume commitment — per-unit pricing tiers often improve meaningfully above certain order thresholds.

wholesaler.typical_moq_notes: Lower MOQ than going direct to a manufacturer, at a higher per-unit price — a reasonable way to market-test before committing to a manufacturer relationship.
verification_red_flags: Cannot identify the original manufacturer at all
Pricing is barely below retail, leaving little real margin to work with
verification_best_practices: Use wholesalers for initial market-testing, not as the long-term primary source once volume justifies going direct
Confirm stock availability in real time — wholesaler inventory is typically shared across many buyers simultaneously
wholesaler.negotiation_notes: Less price flexibility than a manufacturer relationship, but materially faster fulfillment — treat this as a speed/flexibility trade-off, not a cost play.
